name: [⬆️] Steal Size from others!
desc:
🔥 Grow Bigger. Steal Size. Dominate the Map. 🔥

Start at size 1 and grow stronger every second! Defeat other players to steal their size and become MASSIVE. The bigger you are, the more powerful you become. Can you reach insane sizes and rule the server? 💪🌎

✨ Upgrade your stats
💥 Steal size on defeat
🚀 Climb the leaderboard
👑 Become the biggest player alive

Join the group!
